physical_search_policy.contract: Keep Astropy autoperiod grid and candidate separation. At each period and every supplied duration evaluate all phase centers j*min(duration)/oversample < period. Windows are half-open [center-duration/2,center+duration/2) on phases relative to minimum input time. Weighted inside/outside means use each observation exactly once. Evaluate physical memberships without phase binning. Rank newly computed objective values across durations/phases/periods.
physical_search_policy.objectives: snr = depth/sqrt(1/Win+1/Wout); likelihood retains existing Astropy convention 0.5*Win*depth^2. Nonnegative dimming only. No calibrated false-alarm claim.
physical_search_policy.qualification: Finite period/phase/duration grid only, not continuous global optimum or physical timing qualification. Preserve historical failed runs in a labelled validation-only legacy runner.
physical_search_policy.scientific_policy: Reuse Mission 56 policy and independent references byte-for-byte: all 252 trials must pass, ten required period recoveries remain required, numerical goals unchanged.
physical_search_policy.tie_rule: First tested duration (ascending), then first phase, then existing stable period ranking on exact ties

policy.constant_policy: Zero-variance period search may reject with typed error or return finite candidates; neither is evidence of a detection.
policy.false_positive_policy: Count threshold flags on 10 fixed white and 10 fixed AR(1) red nulls separately by algorithm and stage; report denominator and Wilson interval. No false-positive-rate or FAP calibration acceptance threshold.
policy.reference_policy: LS direct weighted sine/cosine/intercept least squares at returned best frequency; allow fast-grid approximation within 0.01 absolute normalized power. BLS exhaustive phase-window weighted two-level regression at returned period and duration gives an upper bound on achievable positive depth SNR, not an independent global period oracle.
policy.required_recovery: Only matching algorithm on uniform synthetic sine/box, normalized and linear_detrended; published BLS normalized and linear_detrended. All other recovery and false-positive outcomes are diagnostics and retained.
policy.sampling_and_preprocessing: Archive selection and synthetic truth fixed before search. Compare identical search settings before/after preprocessing. No tuning to preserve recoveries.
